en.title: Coalition: Interception and Destruction of Ballistic Missile Launched by Houthi Militia Toward Khamis Mushait
en.summary: Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Houthi militants at Khamis Mushait. The coalition also reported destroying two drones targeting the Riyadh region earlier in the day.

stories.title: التحالف: تدمير مسيّرتين باتجاه منطقة الرياض وباليستيين نحو خميس مشيط

en.title: Coalition: Destruction of Two Drones Toward Riyadh Region and Two Ballistic Missiles Toward Khamis Mushait
en.summary: Saudi air defenses destroyed two unmanned drones launched by Houthi militia toward Riyadh and two ballistic missiles targeting Khamis Mushait.

stories.title: الكونغو: مقتل 14 شخصاً إثر تحطم طائرة بينهم اثنان من كبار المسؤولين العسكريين

en.title: Congo: 14 People Killed in Plane Crash Including Two Senior Military Officials
en.summary: A plane crash in Congo killed at least 14 people, including two prominent military officials, according to the Congolese military.

stories.title: رئيس وزراء باكستان: أمن الحرمين الشريفين «خط أحمر»

en.title: Pakistani Prime Minister: Security of the Two Holy Mosques is a "Red Line"
en.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif stated that the security of the Two Holy Mosques represents a red line for his country, reiterating condemnation of attacks targeting Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: رئيس وزراء باكستان يؤكد: «اتفاقية مكة» تهدف إلى تعزيز السلام والاستقرار بالمنطقة

en.title: Pakistan's Prime Minister Affirms: 'Makkah Agreement' Aims to Promote Peace and Stability in the Region
en.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif stated that the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement between Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan is not targeted at any country but aims to promote regional peace and stability. He emphasized that security of the Two Holy Mosques is a red line for Pakistan and called for maintaining open maritime passages amid Middle East conflicts.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye to deepen military cooperation amid escalating Houthi attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye to deepen military cooperation amid escalating Houthi attacks
en.summary: Senior military officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan met in Riyadh to discuss deepening military and intelligence cooperation under the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement. The discussions focused on enhancing defensive capabilities in response to escalating Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia urges global action on water security at the UN

en.title: Saudi Arabia urges global action on water security at the UN
en.summary: Saudi Arabia and Senegal called for increased international cooperation on water security at the UN General Assembly, citing growing scarcity and rising demand as threats to global societies and economies.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Türkiye reaffirm collective defense under Makkah agreement

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Türkiye reaffirm collective defense under Makkah agreement
en.summary: Military leaders from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Türkiye met in Riyadh to reaffirm their commitment to collective defense under the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement and condemned attacks on Makkah and Saudi infrastructure.

stories.title: UN Security Council Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: UN Security Council Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The UN Security Council issued a condemnation in response to Houthi attacks directed against Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia calls for collective global action to strengthen water security

en.title: Saudi Arabia calls for collective global action to strengthen water security
en.summary: Saudi Arabia emphasized the need for international cooperation to improve global water security and implement commitments that support health, food security, economic development and climate resilience.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Emphasizes Collective Action to Enhance Global Water Security at UN Session

en.title: Saudi Arabia Emphasizes Collective Action to Enhance Global Water Security at UN Session
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has called for coordinated international efforts to improve water security globally during a United Nations session.

stories.title: Makkah defense pact ministers condemn attacks on Saudi Arabia, plan urgent military talks

en.title: Makkah defense pact ministers condemn attacks on Saudi Arabia, plan urgent military talks
en.summary: Foreign ministers from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey met in New York to discuss the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement and condemned attacks on Saudi Arabia. They reviewed progress on establishing the pact's institutional structures and working groups.

en.title: BTC falls, heads for weekly gains
en.summary: Bitcoin declined below $84,000 amid elevated interest rate expectations, though it remained positioned for weekly gains exceeding 3%. A cryptocurrency exchange experienced a security breach resulting in $351.6 million in unauthorized transfers.

en.title: The Financier We Don't See
en.summary: A UAE property developer increased first-half 2026 profit by 64% to approximately 3 billion AED while operating cash flow turned negative, illustrating the timing gap between profit recognition and cash arrival in property development.

en.title: Gold falls, heads for weekly loss
en.summary: Gold prices declined on Friday as a stronger dollar and expectations of sustained elevated US interest rates weighed on the market. The dollar index held steady while tracking gains for the week.

en.title: Brent extends losses; WTI falls over 2%
en.summary: Oil prices declined on Friday as markets assessed potential negotiations between the United States and Iran. The spread between Brent and WTI crude widened to its largest level since May.

stories.title: ‎US equities end mixed; Dow falls for third session

en.title: US equities end mixed; Dow falls for third session
en.summary: US stock markets closed with mixed results, with the Dow Jones declining for a third consecutive session.
